name: Lay the Groundwork
text:
You may look at cards you own exiled with Lay the Groundwork.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay {1}. If you do, exile the top card of your library face down with a plan counter on it.
{2}{U}, {T}: Choose a card you own in exile with a plan counter on it. Until end of turn, you may play that card. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard this turn, exile it instead.
